### How to Detect Baseline Anomalies, Forecast and Do Predictive Automation

Dynatrace Davis AI can use any timeseries (from metrics, logs, traces, event ...) and provide additional insights and trigger actions such as
- Alert on abnormal behavior, e.g: unusually spike in traffic
- Forecast system behavior, e.g: are we staying within our error budgets
- Execute predictive automation, e.g: scale our disks to prevent loss of data

The following screenshot is taken from [Automate predictive capacity management with Davis AI for Workflows](https://www.dynatrace.com/news/blog/automate-predictive-capacity-management-with-davis-ai-for-workflows/) which is the inspiration of this tutorial!
![](https://marvel-b1-cdn.bc0a.com/f00000000236551/dt-cdn.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/forecast.png)

To show you how easy it is to do more with observability data in Dynatrace this Notebook is a companion to a 2-part Observability Lab Video Series:
- Part 1: How to Baseline and Forecast any observability signal with Dynatrace
- Part 2: How to Setup Predictive Automation with Dynatrace

#### Part 1 - Davis AI: Different types of Baselining vs Forecasting
Davis AI provides different strategies to baseline your data and to find anomalies to alert on. But baselining can not only be used to configure the anomaly detection - you can also use it to visualize the baseline result with different settings to **simulate** how anomaly detection would work. 

To learn more about Baselining check out:
* [Static Thresholds](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/davis-ai/anomaly-detection/concepts/static-thresholds)
* [Auto-Adaptive Thresholds](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/davis-ai/anomaly-detection/concepts/auto-adaptive-threshold)
* [Seasonal Baselining](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/davis-ai/ai-models/seasonal-baseline)

Forecasting on the other hand allows you to use Davis AI to forecast based on existing data. A full description of the different ways forecasting works internally in Davis check out: [Davis AI Forecast Analysis](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/davis-ai/ai-models/forecast-analysis)

| limit 20

#### Part 2 - Predictive Automation

Lets take some of our forecasted data and define predictive automation using Dynatrace Workflows!

For this we follow the steps as outlined in the Blog Post [Automate predictive capacity management with Davis AI for Workflows](https://www.dynatrace.com/news/blog/automate-predictive-capacity-management-with-davis-ai-for-workflows/)
